editorial.marketOverview: FT reports Nasdaq futures down 2% amid continued Asian chip weakness. Prior US cash losses and elevated volatility remain relevant, but are not live observations.
editorial.whatChanged: The reported futures decline is deeper than the previous 1.4% indication, though exact ticks are unavailable. This reinforces rather than changes the existing bearish tilt. Open Watch remains at 178 events.
editorial.marketInterpretation: A secondary report identifies an approximately 8% prior SOX decline, consistent with semiconductor underperformance. Lower oil and paired yields offer valuation relief but may also reflect defensive positioning. Current QQQ, VXN and breadth are unverified.
editorial.threeDayPath: Wednesday remains vulnerable ahead of 08:30 ET PCE and GDP. Friday's shortened session may amplify swings; Monday offers a normal-liquidity test of stabilization.
editorial.bullCase: Softer inflation, easing yields and a broad semiconductor rebound could reverse the overnight pressure. Dell demand remains supportive but is not confirmation.
editorial.bearCase: Sticky inflation, concrete tariff escalation or persistent chip underperformance could extend weakness through Monday. Futures losses are not guaranteed cash-session outcomes.
editorial.watchNext: Check PCE versus reported 3.2% core annual expectation, GDP, claims and durable goods, then Beige Book at 14:00 ET. Watch QQQ/SOX, breadth, VXN and synchronized yields. No new major earnings catalyst verified.
